patch_description: The current batch can spend several LP calls on very similar networks, especially when the energy ranking clusters related moves together. Preserve the existing energy/dual-benefit ordering, but greedily choose up to seven proposals that are structurally distinct by edge-set symmetric difference before filling the batch with the highest-ranked remaining proposals. Keep the existing random tail for exploration. This gives costly LP evaluations a broader sample of the neighborhood without discarding the current rankings.
